title: [master] Reversed output entry stays uninvoiced (Invoiced Quantity = 0) after reopening a finished production order, causing quantity discrepancy in Inventory Valuation
summary: Fixed an issue where reversed output entries in production orders remained uninvoiced after reopening, causing inventory valuation discrepancies.
key_points: Reversed output entries now correctly track invoiced quantity when production orders are reopened
Prevents inventory valuation discrepancies caused by uninvoiced reversed entries
Fix applied to inventory adjustment calculation logic for production orders
Includes test coverage for the production order reopening scenario
